caption_L1: This is a bar graph titled Revenue of the Portland Trail Blazers from 2001/02 to 2018/19 (in million U.S. dollars). Year is plotted on a categorical scale from 01/02 to 18/19 along the x-axis. Revenue in million U.S. dollars is shown as a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 300 on the y-axis.
caption_L2L3: The revenue has increased in total, by almost 3 times, from 2001/2 to 2018/2019. There are several years where the income is less than the preceeding year. Although there are some years with lower income, generally the income has steadily increased over time.
